invariant:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
check (!rear || front) && (!front_b || front) && (!rear_b || rear)

next.dropped:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
fact x: bool
fact y: bool
check dropped || (!x && rear)
next.front:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
fact x: bool
fact y: bool
check !x || (!y && rear) || (x && y && front)
next.front_b:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
fact x: bool
fact y: bool
check (!x && rear && rear_b) || (!x && front && !rear && front_b) || (!x && !front && y) || (x && !y && rear_b) || (x && y && front_b)
next.rear:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
fact x: bool
fact y: bool
check (!x && front) || (x && y && rear)
next.rear_b:
fact dropped: bool
fact front: bool
fact front_b: bool
fact rear: bool
fact rear_b: bool
fact x: bool
fact y: bool
check (!x && front && y) || (x && y && rear_b)
